#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Add a final 'Thank you for your attention' slide to Q4_financial_report.pptx.

Creates a backup copy (Q4_financial_report.pptx.bak) before modifying.
"""
import os
import shutil
import sys

from pptx import Presentation
from pptx.util import Inches, Pt
from pptx.enum.text import PP_ALIGN

TARGET = "Q4_financial_report.pptx"
MESSAGE = "Thank you for your attention"


def find_target(start_dir):
    matches = []
    skip = {"node_modules", ".git", "__pycache__", ".venv", "venv"}
    for root, dirs, files in os.walk(start_dir):
        dirs[:] = [d for d in dirs if d not in skip]
        for name in files:
            if name.lower() == TARGET.lower():
                matches.append(os.path.join(root, name))
    return matches


def main():
    path = None
    for base in (os.getcwd(), os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))):
        for candidate in find_target(base):
            path = candidate
            break
        if path:
            break
    if not path:
        print("ERROR: %s not found in workspace" % TARGET, file=sys.stderr)
        return 1

    print("Found presentation: %s" % path)

    backup = path + ".bak"
    shutil.copy2(path, backup)
    print("Backup created: %s" % backup)

    prs = Presentation(path)
    before = len(prs.slides)
    print("Slide count before: %d" % before)

    # Pick the best layout for a closing slide:
    # 1) a layout with only a title placeholder,
    # 2) any layout with a title placeholder,
    # 3) the last available layout.
    layout = None
    title_only = None
    for cand in prs.slide_layouts:
        if len(cand.placeholders) == 1 and cand.placeholders[0].placeholder_format.idx == 0:
            title_only = cand
            break
    if title_only is not None:
        layout = title_only
    else:
        for cand in prs.slide_layouts:
            if len(cand.placeholders) > 0 and cand.placeholders[0].placeholder_format.idx == 0:
                layout = cand
                break
    if layout is None and len(prs.slide_layouts) > 0:
        layout = prs.slide_layouts[-1]
    if layout is None:
        print("ERROR: presentation has no slide layouts", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1

    slide = prs.slides.add_slide(layout)
    print("Using layout: %s" % (layout.name or "unnamed"))

    # Fill the title placeholder if present; otherwise add a centered text box.
    title_ph = None
    for ph in slide.placeholders:
        if ph.placeholder_format.idx == 0:
            title_ph = ph
            break

    if title_ph is not None:
        title_ph.left = Inches(0.5)
        title_ph.width = prs.slide_width - Inches(1.0)
        title_ph.top = Inches(2.5)
        title_ph.height = Inches(1.2)
        tf = title_ph.text_frame
        tf.word_wrap = True
        tf.text = MESSAGE
        for para in tf.paragraphs:
            para.alignment = PP_ALIGN.CENTER
            for run in para.runs:
                run.font.size = Pt(40)
                run.font.bold = True
        print("Text placed in title placeholder.")
    else:
        box = slide.shapes.add_textbox(
            Inches(0.5),
            Inches(2.5),
            prs.slide_width - Inches(1.0),
            Inches(1.2),
        )
        tf = box.text_frame
        tf.word_wrap = True
        p = tf.paragraphs[0]
        p.alignment = PP_ALIGN.CENTER
        run = p.add_run()
        run.text = MESSAGE
        run.font.size = Pt(40)
        run.font.bold = True
        print("Text placed in new text box.")

    prs.save(path)
    after = len(prs.slides)
    print("Slide count after: %d" % after)
    print("Saved: %s" % path)
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Add a final 'Thank you for your attention' slide to Q4_financial_report.pptx.

Direct OOXML approach: the .pptx is a ZIP. We add a new slide part
(ppt/slides/slideK.xml), its rels, register it in presentation.xml,
presentation.xml.rels and [Content_Types].xml, then repack, preserving
every other part byte-for-byte. A backup (.bak) is created first.
"""
import os
import re
import shutil
import sys
import zipfile

TARGET = "Q4_financial_report.pptx"
MESSAGE = "Thank you for your attention"

SLIDE_REL_TYPE = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships/slide"
SLIDE_LAYOUT_REL_TYPE = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships/slideLayout"
SLIDE_CONTENT_TYPE = "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.presentationml.slide+xml"
REL_NS = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/relationships"


def find_target(start_dir):
    matches = []
    skip = {"node_modules", ".git", "__pycache__", ".venv", "venv"}
    for root, dirs, files in os.walk(start_dir):
        dirs[:] = [d for d in dirs if d not in skip]
        for name in files:
            if name.lower() == TARGET.lower():
                matches.append(os.path.join(root, name))
    return matches


def slide_number(name):
    m = re.search(r"slides/slide(\d+)\.xml$", name)
    return int(m.group(1)) if m else None


def build_slide_xml(cx, cy):
    """Minimal slide XML with one centered text box containing the message."""
    box_w = int(cx * 0.85)
    box_h = int(cy * 0.16)
    box_x = (cx - box_w) // 2
    box_y = (cy - box_h) // 2
    return """<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>
<p:sld xmlns:a="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main" xmlns:r="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships" xmlns:p="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/presentationml/2006/main">
  <p:cSld name="ThankYou">
    <p:spTree>
      <p:nvGrpSpPr>
        <p:cNvPr id="1" name=""/>
        <p:cNvGrpSpPr/>
        <p:nvPr/>
      </p:nvGrpSpPr>
      <p:grpSpPr>
        <a:xfrm>
          <a:off x="0" y="0"/>
          <a:ext cx="0" cy="0"/>
          <a:chOff x="0" y="0"/>
          <a:chExt cx="0" cy="0"/>
        </a:xfrm>
      </p:grpSpPr>
      <p:sp>
        <p:nvSpPr>
          <p:cNvPr id="2" name="Thanks Text"/>
          <p:cNvSpPr/>
          <p:nvPr/>
        </p:nvSpPr>
        <p:spPr>
          <a:xfrm>
            <a:off x="%d" y="%d"/>
            <a:ext cx="%d" cy="%d"/>
          </a:xfrm>
          <a:prstGeom prst="rect">
            <a:avLst/>
          </a:prstGeom>
        </p:spPr>
        <p:txBody>
          <a:bodyPr wrap="none" anchor="ctr">
            <a:normAutofit/>
          </a:bodyPr>
          <a:lstStyle/>
          <a:p>
            <a:pPr algn="ctr"/>
            <a:r>
              <a:rPr lang="en-US" sz="4000" b="1"/>
              <a:t>%s</a:t>
            </a:r>
          </a:p>
        </p:txBody>
      </p:sp>
    </p:spTree>
  </p:cSld>
  <p:clrMapOvr>
    <a:masterClrMapping/>
  </p:clrMapOvr>
</p:sld>
""" % (box_x, box_y, box_w, box_h, MESSAGE)


def build_slide_rels(layout_target):
    rel = ('<Relationship Id="rId1" Type="%s" Target="%s"/>'
           % (SLIDE_LAYOUT_REL_TYPE, layout_target))
    return ('<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>\n'
            '<Relationships xmlns="%s">\n  %s\n</Relationships>' % (REL_NS, rel))


def main():
    path = None
    for base in (os.getcwd(), os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))):
        for candidate in find_target(base):
            path = candidate
            break
        if path:
            break
    if not path:
        print("ERROR: %s not found in workspace" % TARGET, file=sys.stderr)
        return 1

    print("Found presentation: %s" % path)

    backup = path + ".bak"
    if not os.path.exists(backup):
        shutil.copy2(path, backup)
        print("Backup created: %s" % backup)

    # --- Read all zip entries -------------------------------------------
    with zipfile.ZipFile(path, "r") as zin:
        entries = {}
        for info in zin.infolist():
            entries[info.filename] = (info, zin.read(info.filename))

    missing = [n for n in ("[Content_Types].xml", "ppt/presentation.xml",
                           "ppt/_rels/presentation.xml.rels") if n not in entries]
    if missing:
        print("ERROR: missing expected parts: %s" % missing, file=sys.stderr)
        return 1

    pres_xml = entries["ppt/presentation.xml"][1].decode("utf-8")
    pres_rels_xml = entries["ppt/_rels/presentation.xml.rels"][1].decode("utf-8")
    content_types_xml = entries["[Content_Types].xml"][1].decode("utf-8")

    # --- Slide size ------------------------------------------------------
    m = re.search(r"<p:sldSz\b[^>]*/>", pres_xml)
    if not m:
        print("ERROR: cannot find <p:sldSz> in presentation.xml", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
    sldsz = m.group(0)
    cx_m = re.search(r'cx="(\d+)"', sldsz)
    cy_m = re.search(r'cy="(\d+)"', sldsz)
    if not cx_m or not cy_m:
        print("ERROR: cannot parse slide size", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
    cx, cy = int(cx_m.group(1)), int(cy_m.group(1))
    print("Slide size: %dx%d EMU" % (cx, cy))

    # --- Existing slide ids and rels ------------------------------------
    ids = re.findall(r'<p:sldId\s+[^>]*id="(\d+)"[^>]*r:id="(rId\d+)"[^>]*/>', pres_xml)
    if not ids:
        print("ERROR: no <p:sldId> entries found in presentation.xml", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
    last_sld_id, last_rid = ids[-1]
    print("Existing slides: %d (last: id=%s, rId=%s)" % (len(ids), last_sld_id, last_rid))

    rel_m = re.findall(r'<Relationship\s+[^>]*Id="(rId\d+)"[^>]*Type="([^"]+)"[^>]*Target="([^"]+)"[^>]*/>',
                       pres_rels_xml)
    rel_by_id = {rid: (rtype, target) for rid, rtype, target in rel_m}
    if last_rid not in rel_by_id:
        print("ERROR: last slide rId %s not found in presentation.xml.rels" % last_rid,
              file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
    last_slide_target = rel_by_id[last_rid][1]
    print("Last slide part: %s" % last_slide_target)

    # --- Compute new part names -----------------------------------------
    existing_nums = [n for n in (slide_number(name) for name in entries)
                     if n is not None]
    new_num = (max(existing_nums) + 1) if existing_nums else 1
    new_slide = "ppt/slides/slide%d.xml" % new_num
    new_slide_rels = "ppt/slides/_rels/slide%d.xml.rels" % new_num

    rid_nums = [int(r[2:]) for r in rel_by_id]
    new_rid = "rId%d" % ((max(rid_nums) + 1) if rid_nums else 1)
    new_sld_id = str(int(last_sld_id) + 1)

    # --- Layout for the new slide (reuse last slide's layout) ------------
    last_slide_n = slide_number(last_slide_target)
    layout_target = None
    if last_slide_n is not None:
        last_rels_name = "ppt/slides/_rels/slide%d.xml.rels" % last_slide_n
        last_rels = entries.get(last_rels_name)
        if last_rels is not None:
            lm = re.findall(
                r'<Relationship\s+[^>]*Type="%s"[^>]*Target="([^"]+)"[^>]*/>'
                % re.escape(SLIDE_LAYOUT_REL_TYPE),
                last_rels[1].decode("utf-8"))
            if lm:
                layout_target = lm[0]
    if layout_target is None:
        # Fall back to any slide's layout relationship
        for name in sorted(entries):
            if re.match(r"ppt/slides/_rels/slide\d+\.xml\.rels$", name):
                lm = re.findall(
                    r'<Relationship\s+[^>]*Type="%s"[^>]*Target="([^"]+)"[^>]*/>'
                    % re.escape(SLIDE_LAYOUT_REL_TYPE),
                    entries[name][1].decode("utf-8"))
                if lm:
                    layout_target = lm[0]
                    break
    print("Layout for new slide: %s" % (layout_target or "none found"))

    # --- Build modified parts --------------------------------------------
    modified = {}
    modified[new_slide] = build_slide_xml(cx, cy).encode("utf-8")
    if layout_target:
        modified[new_slide_rels] = build_slide_rels(layout_target).encode("utf-8")

    # presentation.xml: register the new slide id
    if "</p:sldIdLst>" not in pres_xml:
        print("ERROR: </p:sldIdLst> not found in presentation.xml", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
    new_sld_entry = '    <p:sldId id="%s" r:id="%s"/>\n  ' % (new_sld_id, new_rid)
    modified["ppt/presentation.xml"] = pres_xml.replace(
        "</p:sldIdLst>", new_sld_entry + "</p:sldIdLst>").encode("utf-8")

    # presentation.xml.rels: add slide relationship
    new_rel = ('<Relationship Id="%s" Type="%s" Target="%s"/>'
               % (new_rid, SLIDE_REL_TYPE, new_slide))
    modified["ppt/_rels/presentation.xml.rels"] = pres_rels_xml.replace(
        "</Relationships>", "  " + new_rel + "\n</Relationships>").encode("utf-8")

    # [Content_Types].xml: add override for the new slide
    new_override = ('<Override PartName="/%s" ContentType="%s"/>'
                    % (new_slide, SLIDE_CONTENT_TYPE))
    if "/" + new_slide not in content_types_xml:
        modified["[Content_Types].xml"] = content_types_xml.replace(
            "</Types>", "  " + new_override + "\n</Types>").encode("utf-8")

    # --- Repack -----------------------------------------------------------
    tmp = path + ".tmp"
    with zipfile.ZipFile(tmp, "w", zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as zout:
        for name, (info, data) in entries.items():
            zout.writestr(info, modified.get(name, data))
    os.replace(tmp, path)
    print("Added slide: %s (sldId=%s, %s)" % (new_slide, new_sld_id, new_rid))
    print("Slide count now: %d" % (len(ids) + 1))
    print("Saved: %s" % path)
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

    print("Slide count now: %d" % (len(ids) + 1))
    print("Saved: %s" % path)
    return 0

    sys.exit(main())

import os
import shutil
import sys

from pptx import Presentation
from pptx.util import Inches, Pt
from pptx.enum.text import PP_ALIGN

TARGET = "Q4_financial_report.pptx"
MESSAGE = "Thank you for your attention"


def find_target(start_dir):
    matches = []
    skip = {"node_modules", ".git", "__pycache__", ".venv", "venv"}
    for root, dirs, files in os.walk(start_dir):
        dirs[:] = [d for d in dirs if d not in skip]
        for name in files:
            if name.lower() == TARGET.lower():
                matches.append(os.path.join(root, name))
    return matches


def main():
    path = None
    for base in (os.getcwd(), os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))):
        for candidate in find_target(base):
            path = candidate
            break
        if path:
            break
    if not path:
        print("ERROR: %s not found in workspace" % TARGET, file=sys.stderr)
        return 1

    print("Found presentation: %s" % path)

    backup = path + ".bak"
    shutil.copy2(path, backup)
    print("Backup created: %s" % backup)

    prs = Presentation(path)
    before = len(prs.slides)
    print("Slide count before: %d" % before)

    # Pick the best layout for a closing slide:
    # 1) a layout with only a title placeholder,
    # 2) any layout with a title placeholder,
    # 3) the last available layout.
    layout = None
    title_only = None
    for cand in prs.slide_layouts:
        if len(cand.placeholders) == 1 and cand.placeholders[0].placeholder_format.idx == 0:
            title_only = cand
            break
    if title_only is not None:
        layout = title_only
    else:
        for cand in prs.slide_layouts:
            if len(cand.placeholders) > 0 and cand.placeholders[0].placeholder_format.idx == 0:
                layout = cand
                break
    if layout is None and len(prs.slide_layouts) > 0:
        layout = prs.slide_layouts[-1]
    if layout is None:
        print("ERROR: presentation has no slide layouts", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1

    print("Using layout: %s" % (layout.name or "unnamed"))

    # Fill the title placeholder if present; otherwise add a centered text box.
    title_ph = None
    for ph in slide.placeholders:
        if ph.placeholder_format.idx == 0:
            title_ph = ph

        title_ph.left = Inches(0.5)
        title_ph.width = prs.slide_width - Inches(1.0)

            para.alignment = PP_ALIGN.CENTER
            for run in para.runs:
                run.font.size = Pt(40)
                run.font.bold = True
        print("Text placed in title placeholder.")
    else:
        box = slide.shapes.add_textbox(
            Inches(0.5),
            Inches(2.5),
            prs.slide_width - Inches(1.0),
            Inches(1.2),
        )
        tf = box.text_frame
        tf.word_wrap = True
        p = tf.paragraphs[0]
        p.alignment = PP_ALIGN.CENTER
        run = p.add_run()
        run.text = MESSAGE
        run.font.size = Pt(40)
        run.font.bold = True
        print("Text placed in new text box.")

    prs.save(path)
    after = len(prs.slides)
    print("Slide count after: %d" % after)
    print("Saved: %s" % path)
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Add a final 'Thank you for your attention' slide to Q4_financial_report.pptx.

Direct OOXML approach: the .pptx is a ZIP. We add a new slide part
(ppt/slides/slideK.xml), its rels, register it in presentation.xml,
presentation.xml.rels and [Content_Types].xml, then repack, preserving
every other part byte-for-byte. A backup (.bak) is created first and,
if present, restored so processing always starts from the pristine file.
"""
import os
import re
import shutil
import sys
import zipfile

TARGET = "Q4_financial_report.pptx"
MESSAGE = "Thank you for your attention"

SLIDE_REL_TYPE = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships/slide"
SLIDE_LAYOUT_REL_TYPE = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships/slideLayout"
SLIDE_CONTENT_TYPE = "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.presentationml.slide+xml"
REL_NS = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/relationships"


def find_target(start_dir):
    matches = []
    skip = {"node_modules", ".git", "__pycache__", ".venv", "venv"}
    for root, dirs, files in os.walk(start_dir):
        dirs[:] = [d for d in dirs if d not in skip]
        for name in files:
            if name.lower() == TARGET.lower():
                matches.append(os.path.join(root, name))
    return matches


def slide_number(name):
    m = re.search(r"slides/slide(\d+)\.xml$", name)
    return int(m.group(1)) if m else None


def build_slide_xml(cx, cy):
    """Minimal slide XML with one centered text box containing the message."""
    box_w = int(cx * 0.85)
    box_h = int(cy * 0.16)
    box_x = (cx - box_w) // 2
    box_y = (cy - box_h) // 2
    return """<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>
<p:sld xmlns:a="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main" xmlns:r="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships" xmlns:p="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/presentationml/2006/main">
  <p:cSld name="ThankYou">
    <p:spTree>
      <p:nvGrpSpPr>
        <p:cNvPr id="1" name=""/>
        <p:cNvGrpSpPr/>
        <p:nvPr/>
      </p:nvGrpSpPr>
      <p:grpSpPr>
        <a:xfrm>
          <a:off x="0" y="0"/>
          <a:ext cx="0" cy="0"/>
          <a:chOff x="0" y="0"/>
          <a:chExt cx="0" cy="0"/>
        </a:xfrm>
      </p:grpSpPr>
      <p:sp>
        <p:nvSpPr>
          <p:cNvPr id="2" name="Thanks Text"/>
          <p:cNvSpPr/>
          <p:nvPr/>
        </p:nvSpPr>
        <p:spPr>
          <a:xfrm>
            <a:off x="%d" y="%d"/>
            <a:ext cx="%d" cy="%d"/>
          </a:xfrm>
          <a:prstGeom prst="rect">
            <a:avLst/>
          </a:prstGeom>
        </p:spPr>
        <p:txBody>
          <a:bodyPr wrap="none" anchor="ctr">
            <a:normAutofit/>
          </a:bodyPr>
          <a:lstStyle/>
          <a:p>
            <a:pPr algn="ctr"/>
            <a:r>
              <a:rPr lang="en-US" sz="4000" b="1"/>
              <a:t>%s</a:t>
            </a:r>
          </a:p>
        </p:txBody>
      </p:sp>
    </p:spTree>
  </p:cSld>
  <p:clrMapOvr>
    <a:masterClrMapping/>
  </p:clrMapOvr>
</p:sld>
""" % (box_x, box_y, box_w, box_h, MESSAGE)


def build_slide_rels(layout_target):
    rel = ('<Relationship Id="rId1" Type="%s" Target="%s"/>'
           % (SLIDE_LAYOUT_REL_TYPE, layout_target))
    return ('<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>\n'
            '<Relationships xmlns="%s">\n  %s\n</Relationships>' % (REL_NS, rel))


def main():
    path = None
    for base in (os.getcwd(), os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))):
        for candidate in find_target(base):
            path = candidate
            break
        if path:
            break
    if not path:
        print("ERROR: %s not found in workspace" % TARGET, file=sys.stderr)
        return 1

    print("Found presentation: %s" % path)

    backup = path + ".bak"
    if os.path.exists(backup):
        # Restore pristine original before processing (idempotent recovery).
        shutil.copy2(backup, path)
        print("Restored pristine original from backup: %s" % backup)
    else:
        shutil.copy2(path, backup)
        print("Backup created: %s" % backup)

    # --- Read all zip entries -------------------------------------------
    with zipfile.ZipFile(path, "r") as zin:
        entries = {}
        for info in zin.infolist():
            entries[info.filename] = (info, zin.read(info.filename))

    missing = [n for n in ("[Content_Types].xml", "ppt/presentation.xml",
                           "ppt/_rels/presentation.xml.rels") if n not in entries]
    if missing:
        print("ERROR: missing expected parts: %s" % missing, file=sys.stderr)
        return 1

    pres_xml = entries["ppt/presentation.xml"][1].decode("utf-8")
    pres_rels_xml = entries["ppt/_rels/presentation.xml.rels"][1].decode("utf-8")
    content_types_xml = entries["[Content_Types].xml"][1].decode("utf-8")

    # --- Slide size ------------------------------------------------------
    m = re.search(r"<p:sldSz\b[^>]*/>", pres_xml)
    if not m:
        print("ERROR: cannot find <p:sldSz> in presentation.xml", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
    sldsz = m.group(0)
    cx_m = re.search(r'cx="(\d+)"', sldsz)
    cy_m = re.search(r'cy="(\d+)"', sldsz)
    if not cx_m or not cy_m:
        print("ERROR: cannot parse slide size", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
    cx, cy = int(cx_m.group(1)), int(cy_m.group(1))
    print("Slide size: %dx%d EMU" % (cx, cy))

    # --- Existing slide ids and rels ------------------------------------
    ids = re.findall(r'<p:sldId\s+[^>]*id="(\d+)"[^>]*r:id="(rId\d+)"[^>]*/>', pres_xml)
    if not ids:
        print("ERROR: no <p:sldId> entries found in presentation.xml", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
    last_sld_id, last_rid = ids[-1]
    print("Existing slides: %d (last: id=%s, rId=%s)" % (len(ids), last_sld_id, last_rid))

    rel_m = re.findall(r'<Relationship\s+[^>]*Id="(rId\d+)"[^>]*Type="([^"]+)"[^>]*Target="([^"]+)"[^>]*/>',
                       pres_rels_xml)
    rel_by_id = {rid: (rtype, target) for rid, rtype, target in rel_m}
    if last_rid not in rel_by_id:
        print("ERROR: last slide rId %s not found in presentation.xml.rels" % last_rid,
              file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
    last_slide_target = rel_by_id[last_rid][1]
    print("Last slide part: %s" % last_slide_target)

    # --- Compute new part names -----------------------------------------
    existing_nums = [n for n in (slide_number(name) for name in entries)
                     if n is not None]
    new_num = (max(existing_nums) + 1) if existing_nums else 1
    new_slide = "ppt/slides/slide%d.xml" % new_num
    new_slide_rels = "ppt/slides/_rels/slide%d.xml.rels" % new_num
    # Target inside presentation.xml.rels is relative to /ppt/
    new_slide_rel_target = new_slide[len("ppt/"):]

    rid_nums = [int(r[3:]) for r in rel_by_id]
    new_rid = "rId%d" % ((max(rid_nums) + 1) if rid_nums else 1)
    new_sld_id = str(int(last_sld_id) + 1)

    # --- Layout for the new slide (reuse last slide's layout) ------------
    last_slide_n = slide_number(last_slide_target)
    layout_target = None
    if last_slide_n is not None:
        last_rels_name = "ppt/slides/_rels/slide%d.xml.rels" % last_slide_n
        last_rels = entries.get(last_rels_name)
        if last_rels is not None:
            lm = re.findall(
                r'<Relationship\s+[^>]*Type="%s"[^>]*Target="([^"]+)"[^>]*/>'
                % re.escape(SLIDE_LAYOUT_REL_TYPE),
                last_rels[1].decode("utf-8"))
            if lm:
                layout_target = lm[0]
    if layout_target is None:
        # Fall back to any slide's layout relationship
        for name in sorted(entries):
            if re.match(r"ppt/slides/_rels/slide\d+\.xml\.rels$", name):
                lm = re.findall(
                    r'<Relationship\s+[^>]*Type="%s"[^>]*Target="([^"]+)"[^>]*/>'
                    % re.escape(SLIDE_LAYOUT_REL_TYPE),
                    entries[name][1].decode("utf-8"))
                if lm:
                    layout_target = lm[0]
                    break
    print("Layout for new slide: %s" % (layout_target or "none found"))

    # --- Build modified parts --------------------------------------------
    modified = {}
    modified[new_slide] = build_slide_xml(cx, cy).encode("utf-8")
    if layout_target:
        modified[new_slide_rels] = build_slide_rels(layout_target).encode("utf-8")

    # presentation.xml: register the new slide id
    if "</p:sldIdLst>" not in pres_xml:
        print("ERROR: </p:sldIdLst> not found in presentation.xml", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
    new_sld_entry = '    <p:sldId id="%s" r:id="%s"/>\n  ' % (new_sld_id, new_rid)
    modified["ppt/presentation.xml"] = pres_xml.replace(
        "</p:sldIdLst>", new_sld_entry + "</p:sldIdLst>").encode("utf-8")

    # presentation.xml.rels: add slide relationship (target relative to /ppt/)
    new_rel = ('<Relationship Id="%s" Type="%s" Target="%s"/>'
               % (new_rid, SLIDE_REL_TYPE, new_slide_rel_target))
    modified["ppt/_rels/presentation.xml.rels"] = pres_rels_xml.replace(
        "</Relationships>", "  " + new_rel + "\n</Relationships>").encode("utf-8")

    # [Content_Types].xml: add override for the new slide
    new_override = ('<Override PartName="/%s" ContentType="%s"/>'
                    % (new_slide, SLIDE_CONTENT_TYPE))
    if "/" + new_slide not in content_types_xml:
        modified["[Content_Types].xml"] = content_types_xml.replace(
            "</Types>", "  " + new_override + "\n</Types>").encode("utf-8")

    # --- Repack (existing parts keep metadata; new parts are written too) --
    tmp = path + ".tmp"
    with zipfile.ZipFile(tmp, "w", zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as zout:
        for name, (info, data) in entries.items():
            zout.writestr(info, modified.get(name, data))
        for name, data in modified.items():
            if name not in entries:
                zout.writestr(name, data)
    os.replace(tmp, path)
    print("Added slide: %s (sldId=%s, %s)" % (new_slide, new_sld_id, new_rid))
    print("Slide count now: %d" % (len(ids) + 1))
    print("Saved: %s" % path)
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
